scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @bridgecabs/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @bridgecabs/design-tokens build && pnpm --filter @bridgecabs/api-client build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter dispatch-web build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('apps/dispatch-web/dist') && !fs.existsSync('dist')) { fs.cpSync('apps/dispatch-web/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter dispatch-web test
